pr.title: Implement global draft version and version support for visual editing
pr.body:
## Scope

This feature branch adds content version support to the Visual Editor, enabling draft version creation, editing, and live preview within the visual editing workflow.

### Sub PRs (all previously reviewed and merged into this branch)

- https://github.com/directus/directus/pull/26507
- https://github.com/directus/directus/pull/26720
- https://github.com/directus/directus/pull/26749
- https://github.com/directus/directus/pull/26760

### Related library PR

- https://github.com/directus/visual-editing/pull/34

## Potential Risks / Drawbacks

- Changes to `use-collab.ts` in the regression audit commits modify the version type signature (`ContentVersion` → `ContentVersionMaybeNew`) and add a guard for unsaved versions (`version.value?.id === '+'`). This change needs careful human review as it affects the shared collaboration layer.

## Tested Scenarios

- Refer to individual sub-PR descriptions for their respective test scenarios
- Additional regression audit after merging all sub-PRs verified version key handling in version list, collaboration composable, and revisions sidebar

## Review Notes / Questions

- All sub PRs were already reviewed individually, but additional regression audit commits ([1dc9449](https://github.com/directus/directus/pull/26772/commits/1dc94492bfcbfb76381d03325e6a5574a46f5fb0), [1eb92db](https://github.com/directus/directus/pull/26772/commits/1eb92dbaca59808373b8128404e08988b46bee4d)) were made after merging them into this branch
- **`app/src/composables/use-collab.ts` needs another human review** — the regression audit changed the version parameter type and added an early return guard for new (unsaved) versions
- Other regression audit changes are minor: consistent version key usage in revisions sidebar detail and visual editor route
- After pulling, rebuild system-data: `pnpm --filter system-data build`
- To test end-to-end, the companion library PR https://github.com/directus/visual-editing is required. Use the [visual-editing test-website](https://github.com/directus/visual-editing/blob/main/test-website/readme.md) for setup instructions.

## Checklist

- [x] Added or updated tests
- [x] Documentation PR created [here](https://github.com/directus/docs/pull/547) or not required
- [x] OpenAPI package PR created [here](https://github.com/directus/openapi) or not required

---

Fixes CMS-1873
pr.head: feat/versions-for-visual-editor

commits.message:
vev ← Add global draft version support (#26507)

* refactor version handling and add support for draft versions

* fix: update version key global check and disable inputs accordingly

* fix: update type handling for currentVersion to support ContentVersionWithType

* enhance list item styling and add content edited tooltip

* docs: update content version types documentation for clarity

* fix: update version type handling in revisions

* fix type

* fix: update version type in v-form and applyConditions

* fix: update currentVersion type in validateItem function

* fix: use getVersionDisplayName for version display names in useFakeVersionField for consistency

* optimize version deletion

* fix: ensure currentVersion is reset only when collection changes

* refactor: replace ContentVersion with ContentVersionMaybeNew type in form-field and form-field-interface components

* add changeset

* add tests

* Update app/src/modules/content/components/version-menu.vue

* improve types of comparable version

* Add reserved version key validation and tooltip in version menu

* Refactor version filtering logic to remove global version keys dependency

* Remove divider between Draft and local versions in version menu component (to avoid confusion)

* change API response handling in getVersions function

* update changeset

* fix issue where drafts were not deleted after promotion

---------

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+---
+'@directus/app': minor
+---
+
+Added support for a global draft version that is automatically available for all items when versioning is enabled
+
+::: notice
+
+Backward Compatibility: If you have an existing version with the key `draft` and a custom name other than “Draft”, the display name will be standardized to “Draft” (i.e. transformed) to support the new global versioning feature. The version content and functionality remain unchanged.
+
+:::

@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+---
+'@directus/app': minor
+---
+
+Added field permission and version access checks to Visual Editor
+
+::: notice
+
+The field access checks require an update of the `@directus/visual-editing` library to v2.0.0.
+
+:::

@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+'@directus/app': minor
+---
+
+Added version support for visual editing in live preview
